subject: Improve R fluency - who wants to join me in a motivation/working group?

messages.author: 80f3b08eb9d82ac3
messages.subject: Improve R fluency - who wants to join me in a motivation/working group?
parts:
Hi R-users,

While I've been successful with occasional use of R for graphics and analysis, I want to be able to write code with less copy/paste and google searching. I want to not hate for loops.  I know what I need is practice, practice, practice; I also know I'll need some accountability to make this happen.  Is anyone else in the same boat?  Are you interested in joining me in a small, relaxed-pace practice group?  My goal would be to find practice data, set goals and deadlines, and review output for accuracy, graphics design, and text interpretation. 

My specific goals are: 
- scrape data
- data tidying 
- data summaries
- r Markdown
- using Github

I intend to set achievable deadlines, understanding we all have other commitments, so this doesn't need to be intense or strenuous.  

What are your goals?  Maybe this exists already - can I join you? 

Meghan
